notes: Placement fix and typing for the SMAA Indoor Track Championship (2/8/2025, USM; Hy-Tek PDF printed in three columns, read column by column). The parse (LooseListParser) kept every mark, name, team code and relay school as printed but dropped the Place column from all 926 result rows (place None; the meet prints no points and no team scores) and typed the 175 'Preliminaries' rows (55 Meter Dash/Hurdles, Junior/Senior, both sexes) as Finals. Corrections: place added to every row as printed (ties repeat the number: Girls High Jump 8 Kelly/8 Yokota); the Preliminaries rows are type Prelims (marks lose the printed q); the Boys 4x200 Meter Relay OPEN BOYS DNF row of Marshwood had school '--- Marshwood High School A' (status marker and relay letter glued in): school Marshwood High School, result DNF kept as the parse had it. Everything else is an unchanged copy checked row by row against the PDF (names as printed 'Last, First', team codes as printed: SPHS, POHS, GHS, FALH, DEER, WIND, MARH, CHEV, BIDH, BEHS, THOA, NOHS, KENH, SANH, WEHS, MASH, SCAR; Junior/Senior/Open divisions are separate events as in the parse). Status rows the parser leaves out stay out: 15 (NH x6, DQ x7 incl. relays, DNF x1, FS x1). PARSER PATTERNS: (a) LooseListParser on a Hy-Tek multi-column PDF drops the 'Lane'-headed place column (rank numbers) of every row; (b) Preliminaries sections under 'Preliminaries ... (Event)' continuation headers get type Finals; (c) a '---' status relay row keeps '--- ' and the relay letter in the school. School codes (raw -> catalog id, evidence: the same file prints the full relay names Portland/Cheverus/Deering/South Portland/Windham/Kennebunk/Noble/Falmouth/Scarborough/Gorham/Marshwood/Sanford/Thornton/Bonny Eagle/Biddeford/Massabesic/Westbrook High School and the 17 SMAA teams): SPHS me-hs-south-portland, POHS me-hs-portland, GHS me-hs-gorham, FALH me-hs-falmouth, DEER me-hs-deering, WIND me-hs-windham, MARH me-hs-marshwood, CHEV me-hs-cheverus, BIDH me-hs-biddeford, BEHS me-hs-bonny-eagle, THOA me-hs-thornton, NOHS me-hs-noble, KENH me-hs-kennebunk, SANH me-hs-sanford, WEHS me-hs-westbrook, MASH me-hs-massabesic, SCAR me-hs-scarborough (all already resolved correctly by the catalog).
